import { gettingStartedGuides } from './getting-started-guides'
import { workflowGuides } from './workflow-guides'
import { customizeGuides } from './customize-guides'
import { layoutGuides } from './layout-guides'
import { contentGuides } from './content-guides'
import { formsGuides } from './forms-guides'
import { helpersGuides } from './helpers-guides'
import { utilitiesGuides } from './utilities-guides'
import { contrastGuideSlugs, contrastExample, demoContrastCss } from './contrast-examples'

export interface CodeSample {
  label?: string
  language: string
  source: string
}

export interface GuideSection {
  heading: string
  level?: 2 | 3
  steps?: string[]
  paragraphs?: string[]
  code?: CodeSample[]
  table?: { headings: string[]; rows: string[][]; keyboardScroll?: boolean }
  callout?: string
  example?: string
}

export interface Guide {
  /** MDX entries expose navigation metadata here; their bodies are in content/docs. */
  source?: 'mdx'
  slug: string
  group: string
  title: string
  description: string
  lead: string
  sections: GuideSection[]
  reference?: { title: string; url: string }
  clientScript?: string
}

export const guides: Guide[] = [
  ...gettingStartedGuides,
  ...workflowGuides,
  ...customizeGuides,
  ...layoutGuides,
  ...contentGuides,
  ...formsGuides,
  ...helpersGuides,
  ...utilitiesGuides
].map(guide => guide.source === 'mdx' || !contrastGuideSlugs.has(guide.slug) ? guide : ({
  ...guide,
  sections: [
    { heading: 'Explicit demo contrast customization', paragraphs: ['These examples opt into application CSS with darker solid backgrounds and emphasized foregrounds. This is not a change to framework defaults. Copy this CSS and the demo-contrast wrapper together. Calendar examples also pass a styles option to the dependency.'], code: [{ language: 'css', source: demoContrastCss }] },
    ...guide.sections.map(section => ({ ...section,
      example: section.example ? contrastExample(section.example) : undefined,
      code: section.code?.map(sample => sample.language === 'html' ? { ...sample, source: contrastExample(sample.source) } : sample)
    }))
  ],
  clientScript: `${guide.clientScript ?? ''}\nconst demoStyle = document.createElement('style'); demoStyle.textContent = ${JSON.stringify(demoContrastCss)}; document.head.append(demoStyle);`
}))

export const guideGroups = Object.entries(
  guides.reduce<Record<string, Guide[]>>((groups, guide) => {
    ;(groups[guide.group] ??= []).push(guide)
    return groups
  }, {})
)
